correctness.rationale: The source recurrence gives row sums \(\frac{1}{n-1}\sum_{j\ne i}\delta^{d(i,j)}\). Cycle symmetry makes this a constant row sum and hence the Perron root. The star update has a two-block form with nonzero eigenvalues \(\pm\delta\sqrt{\frac{1+(n-2)\delta}{n-1}}\). Exact comparison reduces to \(P_n(\delta)\); direct identities settle \(n=3,4,5\), and the coefficient-sign/factorization argument proves \(P_n(\delta)>0\) for every \(n\ge6\) and \(0<\delta<1\).
